current_primitive: A text column carries an update timestamp whose temporal validity depends on each writer.
material_effect: Lexical timestamps can admit invalid values, weaken temporal comparison, and move timezone interpretation into every application path.
target_state: The database preserves update instants with a native timezone-aware temporal type and emits canonical UTC values at interchange boundaries.

disposition.rationale: An expand-and-contract migration preserves compatibility while the native temporal column becomes authoritative.

compatibility.transition_behavior: The expand phase adds the native column, dual-write verification establishes parity, and a later contract phase retires the legacy projection.
compatibility.verification: Representative instants round-trip through both application releases and converge on one canonical UTC serialization.

recovery.containment: The cutover retains the verified legacy projection through the compatibility window.
recovery.replacement_behavior: Routing returns to the retained projection while the migration runner records a successor plan.
recovery.verification: The recovery rehearsal confirms record parity and application health from the retained projection.
